_rules: This file is the queue. Published state lives on disk: a topic is consumed when a posts/*-<slug>.md file exists. No status fields — delete a post file to re-open its topic.
Rotation: the next pick must differ in `type` from the most recently published post. Three types cycle: question (SEO head terms), fact-world (the product in text), definition (category/GEO terms).
`python3 build.py next` applies both rules and scaffolds the pick. Written at brief time, not publish time.
Never two `question` posts on consecutive days — fact-worlds are the product; they must stay the plurality.
Add topics at the bottom. Never reuse a slug. If a topic stops making sense, delete the row — the file is the decision log via git.
